title: Money word problems & value
examples: How do I know which item is the best value?
Can you show me a problem with two steps?
What if the prices are in different units?

explain.say: Today we are learning to solve money problems.

items: Solving problems with more than one step.
Figuring out the best deal when buying things.

explain.say: First we look at multi-step problems.

items: Start: Find the cost of item one.
Middle: Find the cost of item two.
End: Add both costs together for the total.

explain.say: For example you buy three pencils costing fifty cents each.
Next we learn to find the best value.
To find the best value we find the cost for one item.

draw.text: Cost per item = Total cost / Number of items

explain.say: In real life you see this when buying snacks at the shop.

draw.text: Which snack is cheaper per piece?

faq.q: How do I know if I need to add or multiply?
faq.a: If you have the same number of items in different groups, you multiply. If you are combining different amounts, you add.
asks: Do I always add when money is involved?

faq.q: What is the easiest way to compare prices?
faq.a: The best way is to calculate the cost for just one item in each deal you are looking at.
asks: How do I compare two different prices?

faq.q: Can I use decimals when calculating the best value?
faq.a: Yes, you can use decimals for money amounts like pounds and pence. Remember that one pound is one hundred pence.
asks: Do I need to change everything to pence?
How many decimal places should I use?

faq.q: If the problem says 'more than', does that mean I add extra money?
faq.a: It means you need to calculate the total cost and then add the extra amount mentioned in the problem.
asks: What does 'in addition to' mean in money problems?
Should I add the extra amount to the total?

faq.q: What if the problem gives me the total and I need to find the number of items?
faq.a: In that case, you need to divide the total money by the cost of one item to find out how many you bought.
asks: How do I work backward from the total cost?
Is it division if I know the total?

facts: Multi-step problems require you to solve several smaller problems.
To find the best value, you must calculate the unit price.
The unit price is the cost of one single item.
You can find the unit price by dividing the total cost by the quantity.

quiz.say: A pack of 4 stickers costs sixty pence. If you buy 2 packs, what is the total cost?
quiz.why: You find the cost of one pack and then multiply it by two to get the total cost.

wrong.1: You only added the cost of one pack to itself, forgetting to multiply.
wrong.2: You added the cost of four stickers to the cost of two stickers.
wrong.3: You multiplied the number of stickers by the number of packs.

quiz.say: A notebook costs seventy pence. A pen costs twenty pence. If you buy three notebooks and two pens, what is the total cost?
quiz.why: You must calculate the cost of the notebooks first, then the pens, and finally add those two totals together.

wrong.0: You added the cost of three notebooks and then added the cost of two pens, but added an extra ten pence.
wrong.2: You only multiplied the cost of the pen by two and ignored the notebooks.
wrong.3: You added the cost of three notebooks and then added the cost of two pens separately.
